uutiset.t: GB win decider to reach Davis Cup semis for first time since 2019
uutiset.s: Great Britain advance to the semi-finals of the Davis Cup for the first time since 2019 as Henry Patten and Neal Skupski win a decisive doubles tie against Germany in Bologna.

uutiset.t: Lammens - the Man Utd goalkeeper under scrutiny like never before
uutiset.s: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens made two major mistakes in the 2-2 draw with Sporting - could Mauricio Pochettino drop his goalkeeper?

uutiset.t: Wales and Ospreys fly-half Edwards faces months out
uutiset.s: Ospreys and Wales receive a major injury blow with fly-half Dan Edwards ruled out for "a few months" by an ankle injury.

uutiset.t: The American manager with a maths degree making history in La Liga
uutiset.s: Real Sociedad boss Pellegrino Matarazzo made history as the first American manager in La Liga. His side face Crystal Palace in the Europa League on Thursday.

uutiset.t: Zverev too good for Fery in Davis Cup quarter-final
uutiset.s: World number one Alexander Zverev shows his class as he comfortably beats Great Britain's Arthur Fery in straight sets to draw Germany level at 1-1 in their Davis Cup quarter final tie.

uutiset.t: Not even making a 12-man bench - what next for Garnacho?
uutiset.s: Alejandro Garnacho's brief Aston Villa career already looks over, so what next for the 22-year-old?

uutiset.t: Five wins in a row for LA Rams as they beat Green Bay Packers
uutiset.s: Blake Corum stars for the LA Rams as they beat Green Bay Packers 26-13 to secure a fifth successive win in the NFL, to remain firmly in the race to reach the NFC playoffs.

uutiset.t: Norrie holds nerve to beat Struff in Davis Cup quarter-final
uutiset.s: British number two Cameron Norrie gives Great Britain the perfect start to their Davis Cup quarter-final against Germany, as he beats Jan-Lennard Struff in three sets in the opening match of their tie in Bolgona.

uutiset.t: Faldo urges LIV stars to 'chip in' for unpaid firms
uutiset.s: The six-time major winner calls on those who benefited financially from LIV Golf to help small businesses still owed money by the tour.

uutiset.t: Fifa confirms internal data stolen in cyber attack
uutiset.s: Fifa has confirmed it has been the victim of a cyber-attack which resulted in personal and business information being stolen.

uutiset.t: 440 players, three days, one venue - the Nations Championship logistics logjam
uutiset.s: The unprecedented demands of Nations Championship finals weekend have been met by meticulous planning.

uutiset.t: Glenn makes 'free ball' history in WBBL after Dottin timed out
uutiset.s: Watch the moment England's Sarah Glenn makes history in the women's Big Bash League as she bowls at an empty set of stumps with a 'free ball', to dismiss Deandra Dottin after the batter was ruled to have taken too long to face the delivery.

uutiset.t: Bearman to continue with Haas in 2027
uutiset.s: Britain's Oliver Bearman will continue to race for the Haas team in Formula 1 in 2027.

uutiset.t: Botham back as Morgan-Williams to make first start
uutiset.s: Wales flanker James Botham is recalled by head coach Steve Tandy as one of five changes for the Nations Championship finale against Japan.

uutiset.t: Lee stars despite missing club after lesson with F1 stars
uutiset.s: Min Woo Lee shoots a four-under par 68 despite being left without his eight-iron for the first round of the Australian PGA Championship after he gave a golf lesson to Formula 1 stars Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll.
